heading_en: Adjustment of Input Data for the P&L Attribution Test
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式採用最終指定親会社が、承認を受けた場合に限り、リスク理論損益の入力データを仮想損益のそれに合わせる調整を行える旨と、その方法・要件・禁止される調整を定める。
summary_en: Permits an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach, with approval, to adjust the input data of the risk-theoretical P&L to align with that of hypothetical P&L, and sets out the permitted methods, the requirements and the adjustments that are prohibited.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach may, only where it has obtained the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, when using the data for the P&L attribution test, make adjustments to align the input data relating to the risk factors of the risk-theoretical P&L with the input data used for hypothetical P&L (hereinafter in this Article referred to as "adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L").

The adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L shall be made by one of the following methods. (i) A method of replacing the input data of the risk-theoretical P&L with the input data of the hypothetical P&L; (ii) A method of using the input data of the hypothetical P&L as the input data of the risk factors used in the risk-theoretical P&L and in the expected shortfall model.

Where the adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L is made, all of the following requirements shall be satisfied. (i) Internal rules (including policies and procedures) have been established for properly carrying out the adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L; (ii) It has been demonstrated that the differences in the risk factors and calculation methods used are appropriate; (iii) Validation of the adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L is properly carried out; (iv) An assessment (including a comparison before and after the adjustment of the input data) is carried out of the degree of impact of the adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L on the risk-theoretical P&L and the P&L attribution test.

Where, in the adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L, the parameters required for valuation are calculated from the same market data and the methods of calculating those parameters differ between the risk-theoretical P&L and the hypothetical P&L, the difference in calculation methods shall be reflected in the calculation results of the risk-theoretical P&L or the hypothetical P&L.

In the adjustment of input data of the risk-theoretical P&L in the P&L attribution test, the following adjustments shall not be made. (i) An adjustment to make the risk factors of the hypothetical P&L and the risk-theoretical P&L coincide; (ii) An adjustment to eliminate differences arising from different systems and points in time in the calculation of the risk-theoretical P&L and the hypothetical P&L; (iii) An adjustment of parameters calculated in the case provided for in the preceding paragraph.
